title: チームのハッピーエンド

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During a break from team training, I spot Rice Shower looking a little upset.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Everyone was talking about sad things, and listening to them made me sad too… Sniff…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Apparently, the team was chatting during their break and ended up airing grievances about things that happened to them recently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like the others had a lot of fun sharing their stories, but hearing about their misfortunes has really gotten Rice Shower down.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: One of them accidentally stepped in a ditch while taking a walk…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Someone else had a dream where they were being chased by a monster…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And another person accidentally used sugar instead of salt when they were cooking!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: The more I listened to their stories, the sadder I got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, I can't blame her. We all experience emotions differently, and Rice Shower is just more sensitive to these kinds of things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She looks genuinely upset, so I want to help cheer her up.
choice_data_list: Why don't we think of what happened next in each situation?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
choice_data_list: For example, after the person walked into a ditch…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yes?
choice_data_list: She was able to find a missing item she'd lost in there!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I see… So we continue the stories, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The one who was being chased by the monster ended up befriending it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the Umamusume who put sugar in her cooking realized it was tastier that way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I throw more ideas at her, Rice Shower starts to cheer up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness… I'm glad they all had happy endings.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower's mood improves, and she returns to training with a big smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her so happy seems to cheer up <chrname> too, and she looks more relaxed as well.
